name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Everyone, thank you all so much for coming today!」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「It's finally here, the grand finale of the Murakumo Martial Festival！ The pinnacle of Murakumo Academy, the Toujinegi, will be decided！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The venue is filled with the greatest excitement of the year！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「The finals are finally here！ I'm pumped！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Indeed. Now then, I'm sure everyone is already aware, but let's review today's matches.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「In the first semifinal match, Tennouji Victoria versus Kazamine Setsugekka—the winner was Setsugekka.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Setsugekka advances to the finals after defeating last year's Toujinegi, Victoria！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「The Kazamine family's got a reputation for being the administrative types in the Self-Defense Association, y'know, so this really feels like the wave of a new era！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「In the second semifinal match, Kuki Asahi versus Suzakuin Momiji—the winner was Momiji.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Man, I kept thinking, 'Is this really a match between academy students?' They really put on an incredible show！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「As a result, the finals will be a showdown between Kazamine Setsugekka and Suzakuin Momiji—a clash of two Martial Arts Division first-years.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Sakura-san, this year's Martial Festival has been full of major upsets.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah, I never would've guessed that even the finals would end up being a match between two first-years.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「The Martial Arts Division second-years must be sweating bullets right about now. Like, 'Seriously, there are first-years this crazy?'」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Today's finals are obviously the main attraction, sure, but thinking about the future gets me so excited I can hardly stand it！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now, speaking of the finals, what kind of match do you expect it to be, Sakura-san？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Setsugekka, a close-range fighter who charges in with raw power, versus Momiji, who fights with speed and a long blade—they're total opposites.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Setsugekka's gonna want to get inside her guard and clobber her, while Momiji wants to fight at long range where she can make the most of her long blade.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Which means Momiji's definitely not gonna let her get close. It'll probably turn into a matchup of Momiji falling back while Setsugekka chases her down.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Who would you say has the advantage？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Logically speaking, it's Momiji, since she's got the longer reach.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「The longsword is difficult to handle, but Momiji perfectly compensates for that with high precision and speed. She's a real pain to deal with.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「From what I've heard so far, it feels as though Setsugekka is at a massive disadvantage...」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah, but Setsugekka has momentum. Do you remember the mic performance she pulled off in the semifinals？」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Ah, yes. I had my microphone snatched away.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Not to mention myself, but I don't think a first-year student could normally do that on such a big stage.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「W-well, I doubt anyone could have predicted it.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「In short, she's a runaway train. I'm sure she'll pull something off in this match too！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「I see, it sounds like there's going to be another spectacle in the finals！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Yes... oh, right. It seems the preparations are complete.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「And now, everyone, thank you so much for waiting！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The Murakumo Martial Festival final, Setsugekka Kazamine vs. Momiji Suzakuin！ The match will begin shortly！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「This is the climax, the grand finale of this year's Martial Festival! Come on, everyone—get fired up!!」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now, let's welcome Setsugekka Kazamine to the stage！」

name: Umpire
message: 「From the East—Martial Arts Division Year 1, Special Class 'Takamura Class' member！ Setsugekka, Kazamineeeeeeeeeeeee！！！」
Hearing my name called, I walk out onto the competition stage.
I thought I’d be more nervous for the final, but.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Hmm, I feel surprisingly normal）
Whether I’ve gotten used to it or just gone numb, strangely enough, my mind was calm.

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Good look on your face. You've really settled in compared to your first match！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「She brought us such surprise and excitement in the first match and the semifinals. I have no doubt she will show us a magnificent fight in the finals as well！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah, I'm counting on it！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「And now, amidst the roar of the crowd, Setsugekka enters the stage！」
I step out to the center of the stage and come to a stop.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Next, Momiji Suzakuin enters the stage！」

name: Umpire
message: 「From the West—Martial Arts Division Year 1, Special Class 'Takamura Class' member！ Momiji, Suzakuineeeeeeeeeeeee！！！」
Momiji walks slowly toward me from the opposite side. She enters with a dignified expression.

name: Setsugekka
message: （…I finally get to have a match with Momimomi）
I wonder if the last time I fought Momiji in earnest on this field was when I barged into her match against Victoria-senpai.
Everything has changed since then.
Momiji reaches the center of the stage, right before my eyes.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Hah, what's with that stuck-up look?）
She’s usually so lazy, yet she only puts on this 'I am a young lady of the Suzakuin' face at times like this.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……I’m going all out in this match. You better do the same, Momimomi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Naturally. I am a Suzakuin, after all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, well, I suppose so.」
Both Momiji and I carry burdens on our backs.
The Kazamine rests upon my shoulders, and the Suzakuin upon Momiji’s.
I have lived until this day under the protection of the Kazamine.
It is solely thanks to the power of the Kazamine family that I have been able to practice Jindou and reach the finals.
Everything is for this match, to defeat the Suzakuin. To win and prove the superiority of the Kazamine’s power.

name: Umpire
message: 「Both sides, take your stances！！」
I slowly draw my Origami and activate my Tenju.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haa…… haaaaaahhhhh……！！！」
I open my mind's eye and summon my inner god, Mizuchi.

name: Umpire
message: 「Gather the eight million gods in the divine assembly, and deliberate in the divine counsel. Heaven and earth be pure, the six roots be cleansed, be purified, be sanctified……！！」
In this match, I have no reason to hold back, nor do I have the luxury to do so.

name: Setsugekka
message: （I’m going full power from the start……！！）

name: Umpire
message: 「To the East, Kazamine Setsugekka！！」

name: Umpire
message: 「To the West, Suzakuin Momiji！！」
Everything will be decided in this match—！

name: Umpire
message: 「—Bagua ascending, face each other, no time to spare！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Begin the match with honor！！！」
Just as I did with Victoria―senpai, I leap the moment it begins. Closing the distance in one burst―！
Defying my expectations, Momiji flies toward me without a moment’s hesitation.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Oh my！？ Momiji is playing aggressive！ She’s forcing a close-quarters battle against Setsugekka！？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「This is... exquisite. She’s fighting on the very, very edge, not letting herself enter Setsugekka’s range！」
I thought she would run, but she approached me herself.
But that actually played into my hands—or so I thought.
But as Momiji closed the distance, she unleashed a fierce barrage of attacks, refusing to let me enter her own range.
Momiji’s slashes were attacking from every angle. I managed to parry them, but that alone took every ounce of my effort.

name: Setsugekka
message: （…As expected of Momimomi, her counters are fast！）
But it’s a huge mistake if she thinks she can stop me with just this.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mishima-ryuu Type Kanoto, Ginjun！！」
I stopped Momiji’s barrage with the parrying technique I used to deflect Victoria-senpai’s Sonic Rush.
Momiji stepped back slightly. She must have realized she couldn't press the advantage.
But that is precisely my chance！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like I’ll let you run...！」
I closed the distance in an instant—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Self-styled Type Hinoe, Ugachibi Kai！！！」
I extended my arm toward Momiji, like a tiger’s claw gouging into flesh.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Still not enough！！！」
Without a pause, I landed a roundhouse kick to her temple. It’s a technique where I took the Mishima-ryuu form, arranged it into my own style, and developed it into a follow-up combo.
Though she parried it, Momiji was forced back, unable to fully kill the momentum. I pursued her without missing a beat.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I told you I wouldn’t let you get away！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Self-styled Type Kanoe, Kongouhou！！」
The Mishima-ryuu Gouhou is a technique that delivers the power of a stomp directly into a straight-extending punch to deal damage.
Kongouhou channels that destructive energy into the Origami, turning it into the power to crush through the opponent’s Barrier Jacket.
With the power I gained from Mizuchi, I’m activating a Tenju that surpasses even Victoria-senpai’s, forcing her back by sheer might.
It seems that even Momiji can't parry this completely.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come on, come on, what’s the matter, Momimomi！？ You can’t stop me with a pea-shooter like that！！」
Momiji still flashed her blade to chip away at me, but I didn’t even bother defending anymore.
I let some of her slashes hit and shave off my Barrier Jacket as they pleased, while I used parries to close in.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「My Style, Type Tsuchinoe: Houda Chouchuu, Revised！！」
The elbow struck Momiji square in the chest—or so it seemed.
Before I even realized it, she’d wedged her blade into a tiny gap and blocked the direct hit.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Argh, what a technician she is！！）
Still, even if she blocked it, it wouldn’t change the outcome.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ngh…！」
While parrying Momiji’s follow-up strikes, I pressed forward. And further forward. Just kept pushing the pressure.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Oh my—Momiji is being cornered against the wall！？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Setsugekka’s a tank-type, just like Victoria.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「She ignores the minor damage to her Barrier Jacket entirely, using her sheer durability to push her opponent into a corner.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「It’s the ideal style for an infighter！」
That’s right, this is my ideal way of fighting, now that I have the power of Mizuchi. No matter how much I get hit, I just keep pushing！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Rraaaaaaagh！！」
To stop Momiji from escaping the wall, I unleashed a horizontal strike.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m gonna crush you right here！！」
I forced my blade against Momiji as she barely managed to block it.

name: Momiji
message: 「Guh, ughhh…！！」
It turned into a contest of strength, our blades locked against each other.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh, when it comes to power, I’ll never lose to anyone！！」
I shuffled forward, turning the screws on Momiji even more.

name: Momiji
message: 「Don’t you… get cocky！！」
She pushed me back with brute force, trying to slip away quickly.
—But this was the exact scenario I’d been waiting for！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「…Mishima-ryuu Type Kanoe: Hajoushou！！！」
I lunged at Momiji, pouring every bit of the kinetic energy gained from the rapid acceleration into my thrusting hand, slamming it into Momiji’s body with all my might！

name: Momiji
message: 「Nghuuugh…！？」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Ohhh—! Momiji has finally taken a clean hit from Setsugekka!」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Hey now, that was a nasty one！ That’s the high-powered charge technique that slammed Victoria into the wall！！」
Just like the senior, Momiji was slammed into the wall, or so it seemed.
With a graceful twist of her body, she landed on the wall, touching down to the ground as if nothing had happened.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Tsk… she’s so nimble, that Momimomi…！」
I didn't think she'd go down easily, sure, but to shrug off even that last attack without a scratch...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh, whatever! I'll just keep pummeling you until you drop!!」
With that, I kicked off the ground once more—

name: Momiji
message: 「Haaah！！」
I bat back the charging Setsugekka with a rapid volley of strikes from my long blade.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, you're so annoying! Momimomi, hold still for a sec!!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Like hell I will！！」

name: Momiji
message: （Honestly, you're the annoying one here！）
I've managed to seize the initiative and halt her advance, yet I can't push her back at all.

name: Momiji
message: （Any normal swordsman would hate taking a barrage like this！）
No matter how used a swordsman is to having a blade pointed at them, staying within an opponent's range is intensely stressful.
That's why they disengage at the right moment to reset their stance, then close the distance again in a steady rhythm.
Yet right now, Setsugekka hasn't even established her own range, and she's still staying glued inside mine.
On the flip side, the instant I try to create space, she immediately hounds right after me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugaaaah！！」

name: Momiji
message: （Gah, what are you, a starving wild beast）
Throwing all risk and caution to the wind to lunge at me so ferociously—she really was just like a wild beast.
I focus my mind to invoke the state of Shohou Muga that I mastered during my semifinal match against Asahi.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Urya-uryaaah！！」

name: Momiji
message: （...Nope, no way！ Setsugekka, shut up for a second！）
That supreme state I managed to reach against Asahi. Yet facing Setsugekka, there isn't even a hint of it activating.
It's definitely because of those goofy battle cries of hers.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't run away! Original Style, Type Tsuchinoto: Chibashiri Kai!!」
From point-blank range, she sprang upward with her entire body, unleashing a rising diagonal slash.
I blocked it cleanly so I took no damage, yet the impact lifted me effortlessly some thirty centimeters off the ground.

name: Momiji
message: （What insane power...！！）
My hands gripping the sword are faintly numb.

name: Momiji
message: （This is bad—at this rate, she'll overwhelm me...！）
Setsugekka shows no signs of slowing down as she unleashes technique after technique. On the contrary, she's only hitting her stride.
In that case—！

name: Momiji
message: 「……Secret Technique, Triple Swallow Return！！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ngh！？」
Seizing the opening in Setsugekka’s defense, I landed a flawless triple Swallow Return—the fastest series of strikes, executed with no telegraphing.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Oh! Momiji-senshu strikes back! Setsugekka-senshu took that one clean!!」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Damn, that’s scary! That was too fast for the eye to follow!」
The blow clearly took a toll; Setsugekka stumbled slightly. The pressure finally subsided.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That hurts…！ I’m not letting you get away with that！！」
She rushed back into my range, launching a fierce assault.

name: Momiji
message: （Just how sturdy are you！?）
Despite taking the same strike that defeated Shizuku and Asahi, Setsugekka showed absolutely no signs of damage.
How much more did I need to whittle her down to bring her to her knees? A slight shiver ran down my spine.

name: Momiji
message: （This is no time to be getting cold feet！）
Suddenly—a familiar shadow caught the corner of my eye.
…It was Miyako and Tsubaki. They must have come to cheer for me again.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Momiji-onesama, do your best~~！！」
Amidst the chorus of cheers, I faintly heard Tsubaki’s voice. Every time I think of my sisters, I remember my resolve.

name: Momiji
message: （I am the eldest daughter of the Suzakuin Family, Suzakuin Momiji……！）
The Suzakuin Family is the de facto leader of the martial houses in the modern era.

name: Momiji
message: （To be a martial house is to be a gathering of those who rule through martial might. If that is the case, I have no choice but to demonstrate that prowess……！）
Therefore, I, the eldest daughter of the Suzakuin Family, am absolutely forbidden from falling.

name: Momiji
message: （I cannot afford to lose to you here――！）
If she doesn't fall from one strike, I'll hit her twice. If she doesn't fall from two, I'll hit her three times. I’ll keep striking until she goes down！

name: Momiji
message: 「There—！ Secret Technique, Swallow Return！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Gah！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Not done yet！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You think I’m just going to take this lying down!?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「My Style, Type Hinoe: Enko Mouhazan！！！」
Setsugekka unleashed a barrage of attacks, combining faints with Type Hinoe: Ugachibi and Type Hinoto: Enga.
Deceived by her tricky movements, I took the final strike on my arm.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hah! Did you see that? My original technique!」

name: Naruko
message: 「Oh my! Setsugekka’s movements are so agile! She’s really shining now that we’re in the finals, isn’t she, Sakura-san!」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah. In the preliminary matches and the semifinals, she was, in a sense, following the book—her movements were mostly faithful to the basics.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「But now that she’s here, she’s really come alive. That unconventional feel that’s so characteristic of Setsugekka is finally coming out！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「I’ve seen plenty of people bloom after gaining experience on the big stage, but this girl is a remarkably huge talent！」
Indeed, now that she’s in the finals, Setsugekka is showcasing one original technique after another that she had never revealed before.
Since we’ve practiced together forever, I thought I had a handle on her repertoire, but that was a major miscalculation.

name: Momiji
message: （Damn it, I can’t believe a girl like Setsugekka was hiding her trump cards...！）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh heh heh, I use my head a little bit too, you know！ How’s that? Are you intimidated, you dummy, dummy?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Humph, I bet that was just Keisetsu putting ideas in your head, dummy.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, what kind of thing is that to say！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If that’s how it’s gonna be, then take this again! My signature Type Hinoe: Enko Mouhazan!!!」
I block it perfectly this time.

name: Momiji
message: 「You know the rules. The same technique won’t work on me twice.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Tch, you really are a cunning woman, you know that?！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, whatever, I’ve still got plenty more original techniques. Just try and be amazed by my virtuosity！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don’t think you should be saying that out loud. You’re just giving your opponent information.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh, there wasn’t any info in what I just said, was there?」

name: Momiji
message: 「You’ve used five personal techniques so far. Judging by your tone and your personality, I’d say you have between seven and ten of them, right?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「D-d-don’t be stupid! There’s no way that’s true!」

name: Momiji
message: 「And there it is, confirmed.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Grrrrrrr！！ I hate Momimomi！！！」
Compared to someone like Asahi who has two sides to her personality, Setsugekka is much easier to deal with, which is a relief.

name: Momiji
message: （Well, that’s part of Setsugekka’s charm, too.）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If it’s come to this, I’ll just go crazy! I’m going to use all my personal techniques and drive you into a corner!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, go ahead and try if you can.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「My Style, Type Mizunoe: Shirao-taki！！！」
Just as I thought she’d jumped up, she went into a spin, aiming both her heel and blade at the top of my head simultaneously.
I managed to block the blade, but I failed to parry the heel she twisted at the last second, and took a hit to the shoulder.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Still going! My Style, Type Tsuchinoe: Axe Blade Strike!!!」

name: Momiji
message: （So heaaavy……！！！）
A powerful downward swing fueled by brute force.
A strike that felt like it would drive my whole body into the ground. I managed to catch it, but the legs I used to brace myself screamed in protest.

name: Momiji
message: 「You…！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「My Style, Type Hinoto: Spiral Flame!!!」
Twisting her wrist to skillfully entangle the lethal line of my blade, she followed up with a counter palm-heel strike. I barely managed to deflect it.

name: Momiji
message: （Every one of these is an application of the Mishima-ryuu I’ve seen before, but still…！）
The methods of application are sloppy, or rather, lacking in rationality. Because of that, her intentions are hard to read.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Setsugekka-senshu is pressing the attack with all sorts of different moves！！ Momiji-senshu seems to be having a hard time.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Looks like she’s confused by Setsugekka’s style. Can’t blame her; that mobility is off the charts.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Usually, you wouldn't have the stamina to keep moving like that. She must be damn confident in her endurance.」
Yes, that’s the biggest problem.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Damn it, quit just dodging around already！」
Setsugekka has been moving boundlessly since the start of the match without a moment's rest. Yet, she isn't even winded.
No matter how much her Tenju helps her, this level of mobility and stamina is abnormal. What kind of physical constitution does she even have?

name: Momiji
message: （If things keep going like this, I’m going to lose……！！）
To block Setsugekka’s heavy attacks, I need an equal amount of force. In other words, just by defending, my stamina is being chipped away.
It’s clear that if this turns into a war of attrition, I’m at a massive disadvantage.

name: Momiji
message: （Based on the information I have so far, should I make a move now……！！）
Setsugekka’s sword techniques, wind-up motions, range, tactical algorithms, offensive and defensive skills, frequent routines, combination patterns, and the probability of their combinations.
Gaze, facial expressions, blinking, breathing techniques, muscle reflexes, nervous tics, weight distribution, blind-spot compensation, and every other possible physiological reaction.
Psychological tendencies, personality traits, interpersonal judgment, logical reasoning ability, thinking speed, stress tolerance, emotional regulation, and their strategic impact.
The necessary information has been accumulated through acting together and sparring. The only things lacking are the custom techniques.
<center>Then, it is sufficient and complete.</center>

name: Momiji
message: 「――Shingan no Kiwamete, initiate！」
Click, a switch in my brain is flipped.
1st move, approximately 41 types of predicted vanguard actions.
2nd move, total nodes in the action tree resulting from counters is 534.
3rd move 6,921――
4th move 90,953――
8th move――The total number of action tree nodes 20 moves ahead is approximately 5.99e+22.

name: Momiji
message: （Ugh, the custom techniques are increasing the node count...！）
But this much is within the expected range.
Compared to the impact of the Tengen Saimei-ryuu that Asahi showed me, this is nothing.

name: Momiji
message: 「――Pathfinding, complete.」
From the vast number of predicted futures, the optimal solution is derived via an experience evaluation function.

name: Momiji
message: 「Shall we quiet things down a little――！！」
The generated shadow of Setsugekka reveals the trajectory of her eccentric, life-and-death-controlling movements.
The first move is――

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Self-styled Type Kanoe, Kongouhou！！」
1st move, an uppercut from a powerful step, reality consistency 89.221 percent――blade angle minus 12.3 degrees from prediction, data corrected――evade.
2nd move, a horizontal slash to the lower side of the opponent's ribs――hit.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Guh... damn you！ Mishima-ryuu Type Tsuchinoto, Tenzankou！！」
3rd move, a shoulder charge, body slam from close range, reality consistency 99.98 percent――closing speed plus 21.4 m/s from prediction, data corrected, evade.
4th move, a stab while retreating――hit.
5th move evade, 6th move hit, 7th move evade, 8th move hit, 9th move evade. 10th move hit――！！ Evade, hit, evade, hit, hit, hit, hit――！

name: Momiji
message: 「I’ll finish this here！」

name: Momiji
message: 「――Secret Selection, Five Swallow Strikes！！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nghaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh...！！」
Without even giving her a chance to move her fingertips, I slash her Barrier Jacket to pieces with Godspeed swings.

name: Momiji
message: （With this, maybe a little bit...！）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Just kidding.」
Before I knew it—Setsugekka had grabbed my arm.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I've been waiting for this moment, you knooow...！」
I slipped up.
She had seen my Shingan no Kiwamete over and over. That's how she realized it.
That for just a brief moment right after Shingan no Kiwamete ended, there was an opening...

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Aaaah! Momiji's been grabbed by Setsugekka!」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「This is bad！ If she doesn't shake her off fast, Setsugekka's gonna do whatever she wants to her！」
Momiji's Shingan no Kiwamete is a technique where she pushes her brain into overdrive to land a guaranteed flurry of blows on her opponent.
Normally, taking Momiji's barrage deals near-fatal damage. Retaliating with a counterattack is completely out of the question.
At least, that had been true until now. Never realizing there was a fatal blind spot in that certainty.

name: Momiji
message: 「Why, you...！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ghhk...！」
My one blunder was failing to grab Momiji's dominant hand.
Unable to seal her Origami, I took a merciless slash from point-blank range.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hah... Thrash around all you want！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'll just pay you back tenfold for it！！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Th-This is bad！ Momiji is getting relentlessly pummeled by Setsugekka's fists！」
With her unable to escape, I kept relentlessly raining punches down on Momiji.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ora, ora, ora, ora, ora, oraaaaah！！！！」
I didn't even bother aiming. Just a pure, relentless barrage. I hammered my fists into Momiji's body right through her Barrier Jacket！

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Whoa, Momiji actually blocked it with her Origami？！」
Deftly, she started shutting down my punches with her Origami. Because she angled the blade edge into them, my own fists took damage too.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You're so damn annoyiiing！！！」
I cranked up the speed even more, unleashing my fists like a Vulcan cannon. Even so, Momiji deflected more than half of them.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You little... Go dooown！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You're the one going down！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Bugh？！」
Suddenly, the sole of Momiji's foot came flying at me. I took a vicious blow straight to the face, sending sparks exploding across my vision.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hah, hah... hah...！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Ooooh！ With a desperate turnaround kick to the face, Momiji somehow manages to break free from Setsugekka！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Ughhh, that hurts！ No matter what, you don’t just go around kicking a girl in the face！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Look who’s talking, especially since you’ve been pummelling people left and right yourself...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, that felt great, getting to beat up Momimomi so much.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka’s face is big, so it was easy to kick.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yo-you... there’s a line you don’t cross, you know！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s it, you’re done！ I’m going to beat the pulp out of you！！」
I dash into Momiji’s reach, pouring strength into my fist.

name: Momiji
message: 「...I’m going for real now, too.」
From there, Momiji’s fierce counterattack began.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mishima-ryuu Type Kanoto, Ginjun！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: （S-so fast...！）
Momiji swings her long sword with divine speed. Each and every blow crushes my vanguard. I can’t get close at all.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mishima-ryuu Type Mizunoe—Wakinagashi...！！」
Even though I should have parried it perfectly, her blade, which had returned before I knew it, mercilessly gouges into my Barrier Jacket.

name: Setsugekka
message: （T-this, don’t tell me... is this Tsubame Gaeshi...！？）
Tsubame Gaeshi―according to Momiji, it’s a counter―strike technique performed at lightning speed that delivers two blows in a single motion.
Since the swing and the return are a single sequence, it’s hard to adapt; even if you increase the number of returns, there’s no variation in the movement.
Momiji had definitely said that.

name: Setsugekka
message: （No, wait, this... this is on a whole different level, isn't it！？）
It’s too fast for me to see through, but while the speed of the counter-strike is Tsubame Gaeshi, the return movement is different every time.
Was it a lie that it can’t be adapted? No, most likely—

name: Setsugekka
message: （Did she awaken during this match...！?）
Thinking that was against the rules, I remind myself that I also have a self-taught style I used for the first time in this match.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Damn it, I can’t lose to this！！）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「——My Own Style Type Mizunoe—Wakinagashi Kai！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nghghh...！！」
I managed to parry the first few strikes, but I can’t keep up with what comes after. I can’t beat Momiji in speed.
I wish I could at least create an opening, but that’s difficult too.
A normal Tsubame Gaeshi has a slight pause once the return stroke is finished, but there’s none here.
If I had to describe it, this is 《Tsubame Musou》. A Tsubame Gaeshi that continues endlessly until her stamina runs out.

name: Setsugekka
message: （There’s just no way to counter that...！）
Momiji is probably going to pour everything she has into this.
If so, as long as I can weather this storm, I should see an opening to win. Let's fall back and regroup first.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Ghh, I hate having to back off, though...!）
I retreat, pulling back out of Momiji's range—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Gyaaah...！？」
She closes the distance in an instant and unleashes another flurry of strikes. Apparently, she has no intention of letting me escape.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Oooooh, Momiji's going on a ferocious ruuuush！！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「W-What the hell is that?! What kind of speed is that?! Is she a human-powered blender or something?!!」
That confirms it. Momiji intends to settle the match right here. If I can somehow endure this, victory will be—

name: Setsugekka
message: （No, no, no, impossible, no way! I can't hold out against this!）
My Barrier Jacket's alert starts blaring.
Even with all the abundant Tenju I gained from Mizuchi's power, there's no way I can hold up while getting hacked to pieces like this.

name: Setsugekka
message: （This is bad... At this rate, I'm going to lose...！！）
A conversation I had with Kei-chan flashes through my mind.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm going to win this Martial Festival and become the Toujinegi.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, Kei-chan, please promise me. If I become the Toujinegi, you won't go abroad.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Why are you trying to stop me？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Isn't that obvious?!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I mean, you're a student of Takamura Class too, Kei-chan! Everyone's going to be lonely if you leave!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...I see. So that's why.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If you're going to go that far, then I'll see what I can do.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Guhhh...！」
...Kei-chan is always right.
Conscious of her position as a candidate for the next head of the Kazamine family, Kei-chan has always made rational, correct choices.
I've never doubted that for a single moment.
Compared to that, my wish is nothing more than childish, personal selfishness.
Because I knew that, I always went along with everything Kei-chan decided.
Just like Kei-chan has always helped me, I have to help Kei-chan too.
Otherwise, I'm just an unwanted child...

name: Setsugekka
message: （Still, just this once... I really don't want to give up！）
I want to stay here at this academy with Muragaki-sensei and Momimomi. It's an unbelievably selfish wish.
But Kei-chan understood how I felt. She didn't dismiss my wish.

name: Setsugekka
message: （That’s why, that’s why... I absolutely cannot lose this match...！！）
For my sake, and for Kei-chan's sake too.
Next year, and the year after that—I want to stay at this academy with Mr. Muragaki and everyone else...！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...So, don't get in my way！！」
I powerfully deflect Momiji's long sword.
It doesn't matter how hard she strikes. I'll deflect everything.
Faster, even faster.
I still can't catch up to Momiji's speed.
Faster, even faster.
Faster, even faster—！！

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「O-oh my, this is...！ Setsugekka-senshu is accelerating...！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「I’m surprised, she’s actually trying to keep up with Momiji...！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: （Faster, infinitely faster...！！！）
Utilizing every technique I have mastered, I accelerate beyond my limits.
And what was born from that became a new form, and blossomed into a new technique.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「――My Own Style Type Mizunoto: Hatou Ranbu Kai！！！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Whoa, this is a fierce exchange of blows！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I still have things I want to do at this academy！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If I win and become the Toujinegi, that dream will come true！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s why, absolutely！！！ I cannot, I cannot lose, aaaaaahhhhh！！！！」
While being shredded by Momiji’s Tsubame Musou and beaten to a pulp. Still, I throw my fists in a mindless frenzy.
It was now a battle of sheer willpower.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Daaaamn you, just collapse alreadyyyyyyyy！！！」
One flash, two flashes, three flashes, a Tsubame-gaeshi that continues on endlessly. She keeps up an infinite barrage of god-speed counterstrikes.
Based on principle alone, it should have been the strongest.
And yet—

name: Momiji
message: （How in the world can she keep up with that speed...！？）
I want to voice a grievance or two against Keisetsu for applying such secret arts.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uraurauraurauraurauraaaaaaahhh！！！」
And each of those blows is far heavier than my own strikes. Thinking about it, this is just cowardly.

name: Momiji
message: （Then, I’ll just make it so you can’t keep up...！！）
Faster, even faster.
Faster than anyone could ever catch—！！

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「O-oh, something terrifying is happening...！ Momiji is moving even faster now...！！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「That’s nothing short of a gale-force wind, that is...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hah, haah, haaah, haa...！！」
Having moved without pause, I began to lose my breath. But Setsugekka’s movements still showed no signs of slowing down.

name: Momiji
message: （If I run out of gas first... I’m going to lose...！！）
This is the moment I have to hold on—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Still not enoughhh！！！」
I failed to block just one strike from Setsugekka’s flurry, and my body was blown off to the side.
At this rate, I’m going to be slammed into the wall—

name: Momiji
message: 「Dammit alllll...!!」
I drove my blade into the reinforced ceramic tile to kill my momentum.

name: Momiji
message: 「I won’t let it end here like this！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Momiji has turned it around！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah！！！」
I clashed blades with Setsugekka once again.

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m going to tear you to pieces right here and now！！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s my line, damn youuu！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, huff... ugh...！」
I grit my teeth.
It hurts, I’m out of breath.
But if I stop now, I’ll be helpless against Setsugekka’s onslaught, and the match will be over.
But, even knowing that.

name: Momiji
message: （I’m at my... limit...！！）
My vision is blurring. I can’t put any strength into my body.

name: Momiji
message: （Ah... could it be that I’m... going to lose？）
Suddenly, Setsugekka’s face entered my field of vision.

name: Momiji
message: （…She looks so intense, doesn’t she, Setsugekka）
Setsugekka was extending her fist toward me with an expression of desperation I had never seen before.
That was only natural, as Setsugekka had made a promise to Keisetsu.
She desperately wanted to stay at this academy with Iori-sensei. That was why she wanted to win and become the Toujinegi.
Then... wouldn't it be fine? If I just let her win.
I'll grant Setsugekka her wish.

name: Momiji
message: （That's right, even if I lose, what do I have to lose...）
For a split second, I hesitate over whether to dodge Setsugekka's incoming fist.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Big sister, Momiji-neechan...！！」
All of a sudden, I thought I heard Tsubaki's voice.
Setsugekka's fist passes right beside my face.

name: Momiji
message: 「...No good, right.」
That's right... after all, I can't afford to lose.
Behind me are my cute little sisters.
I could never do anything that betrays those girls cheering for me.

name: Momiji
message: （Pleasing one side leaves the other unsatisfied, huh?）
Both Setsugekka and my sisters are precious to me, and
Yet I can't have both, and
To protect one, having no choice but to give up the other
Still, no matter how we had met, we probably would have settled things eventually.

name: Momiji
message: （As long as I am a Suzakuin and you are a Kazamine... this battle surely can't be avoided...！）
In that case, there was no point avoiding the match here.

name: Momiji
message: 「Haa, ha... haaah...」
My breathing was labored, and my thoughts were getting scattered.
My consciousness was slipping away. Not a single emotion came to mind anymore.
...Maybe that was for the best.
All at once—I saw that "wind."

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ura-ura-ura-uraaaahhh！！！」
I moved following the "wind."
With just that, Setsugekka's fists naturally bypassed me. It was a strangely mysterious sensation.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「W-What's this, competitor Momiji has suddenly stopped attacking！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah... looks like she's entered the zone.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The zone, you say？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Near the end of the semifinals, Momiji's movement suddenly changed, right? This has gotta be the same thing as that！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-Why isn't it landing！？」
Setsugekka's movements, which had been launching attacks at the same speed as mine until just moments ago, looked terribly sluggish.
The "wind" that emerges by accepting things as they are, feeling them as they are, and uniting one's actions with the flow of all things.
Now, however, those layered "winds" appeared to me as a single connected "path."

name: Momiji
message: （...I see, so that's how it is）
The vision of the future drawn by Shadow, which I once saw through the Shingan no Kiwamete via an experience evaluation function.
This “path” is surely of the same nature as that.
This is by no means some special ability bestowed upon me by the gods.
It is simply that what I had already mastered now appears differently to me, having passed through the state of Shohou Muga.
Another way of seeing things that Iori taught me.

name: Momiji
message: （Thank you, Iori...）
All I need to do is commit myself to that “path”.
Not because I decide, nor because I move myself.
I just need to follow the predetermined “path” and perform the movements correctly.
Yes, so like a dance, I need only to dance—
When it was Asahi, the “wind” vanished halfway through.
That was because I couldn't fully accept her hatred.
Just as one cannot obtain the correct solution if one filters information arbitrarily.
Unless I accept what is there, exactly as it is, the “wind” will not point to anything at all.
But now, there was no need for such concern.

name: Momiji
message: （...I understand, Setsugekka）
What Setsugekka thinks, what she seeks, and how much desire she carries as she directs her fists at me.
I can feel it all, everything, as if I were holding it in my hands.
That is precisely why it is painful, and why it is sad.
Setsugekka wants Iori to remain at this academy.
If she only wanted to be with Iori, she could have accepted Keisetsu's proposal to ask him to be a private coach.
But Setsugekka resisted that.
Even if it meant rebelling against Keisetsu, whom she had silently obeyed until now, she tried to keep Iori at this academy.
Why is that?

name: Momiji
message: （...You really do want to be with him, don't you）
Because the time we spent together at this academy—me, Asahi, Ririmu, and everyone—was fun.
That is why, even after this Martial Festival ends.
She wants to spend time together at this academy next year, and the year after that.

name: Momiji
message: （That’s right, isn’t it... I feel the same way, Setsugekka...！）
While knowing Setsugekka’s true thoughts, her feelings as they truly are.
I must strike down Setsugekka’s heartfelt wish—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hit him！ Please, just hit him, ahhhhh！！！」
Ah—if only I truly could.
I wish I could have met Setsugekka in a different way.
I wish I could have competed with Setsugekka without any sorrow.
I wish we could have just been friends—

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m sorry, Setsugekka……！！！」
For the first time, I felt truly glad to have been born a Suzakuin.
“Independent and self―reliant”―never in my wildest dreams did I think that teaching would one day be my salvation.
Setsugekka, even knowing how you feel—

name: Momiji
message: 「Even so, I must move forward！！！」
The “path” we are walking is already in sight. There was no room to stop.
I ready the Tsubakuro Nagamitsu and stare down Setsugekka.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uggghhhhhhhhhhh…………！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「――Secret Technique, Suzaku Enbu！！！！！」
I sheathe my Origami and slowly turn back.

name: Momiji
message: 「……Forgive me, Setsugekka.」
Setsugekka did not stand up again.

name: Umpire
message: 「……Match over！！！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Eastern side, Kazamine Setsugekka’s Barrier Jacket has been confirmed destroyed！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Therefore, Western side, Suzakuin Momiji is declared the winner！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「I-i-it’s all over----------！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The winner of this year’s Murakumo Martial Festival is Suzakuin Momiji！！ It’s a victory for Suzakuin Momiji！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The title of Toujinegi shall now be bestowed upon Suzakuin Momiji！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Oh, oooooo～～～! You did well, Momiji!」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Setsugekka fought bravely, though she fell just short. Sakura-san, what are your thoughts looking back on the match？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Man, they both gave it their all！ That was an incredible match！ It was a true nail-biter—it could’ve gone either way！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「It drew a lot of attention as a showdown between Kazamine and Suzakuin, but the result followed expectations with Suzakuin taking the victory.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Well, maybe if you only look at the results, but I don’t think anyone expected Kazamine to put up such a fight！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「The administration can’t treat her like a joke anymore after this！？」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now, regarding the schedule after the match.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「At 1:00, the ceremony will be held for the former Toujinegi to pass the mantle to the new Toujinegi, followed by the Sword Dance Ceremony performed by the new Toujinegi.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「From 2:00, the new Toujinegi will give her inaugural address and hold an interview！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「We will also be holding a conversation between the new Toujinegi and Nakamura Sakura here at the venue, so please look forward to it！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now then, please wait at the venue for a little while…！」
